messages:
sri: Heads up — fp8 CI scorecard just showed a ~2.3% regression for model-x (small-batch). Posting artifacts and initial notes.
ci-bot: CI run: https://ci.redwood/internal/changes/4888  artifacts: /artifacts/4888/scorecard.json  (build 4888)
maria: Looking. Which metric? best_of or token-weighted mean?
sri: best_of_1_accuracy_top10 specifically — expected 0.872 -> 0.851 in the diff panel. Drilldown shows tons of samples marked as 'truncated' or with very small token counts.
oliver: That smells like the `token_trim` change we landed in the eval-runner last week (to remove empty/whitespace tokens).
kevin: Yep — we added token_trim=true as a default in runner to reduce noise. Didn't think it would affect weighting.
sri: It does because the dashboard aggregates by token counts now. If pred_tokens get trimmed down, denominator changes and the weighted average shifts.
maria: Can you paste the metric calculation snippet so we can confirm where the denom is coming from?
oliver: Snippet:
```python
# score.py
pred_tokens = normalize_tokens(pred)
ref_tokens = normalize_tokens(ref)
overlap = compute_overlap(pred_tokens, ref_tokens)
precision = overlap / len(pred_tokens)
```
normalize_tokens now calls `tokenize(..., trim=True)` so empty tokens are removed.
kevin: If len(pred_tokens) drops to 0 we guard to 0, and per-sample weight becomes 0 too. But previously we weighted by raw token_count, so averages are different.
eva: Also the CI runner telemetry currently only emits the post-normalize token_count. So the dashboard has no visibility into raw vs trimmed counts.
maria: Two reasonable fixes: revert token_trim in eval-runner, or add raw_token_count telemetry and switch dashboard aggregation back to raw counts.
sri: Prefer to instrument rather than revert. Add raw_token_count to telemetry and expose trimmed vs raw in the drilldown so we can audit.
kevin: I'll open a PR to emit both raw and trimmed counts (telemetry schema bump). PR 5021. ETA ~2h.
oliver: I'll prepare the dashboard SQL change: use SUM(raw_token_count) for denom in token-weighted metrics and add a column for trimmed/raw in the drilldown table. PR 5022. ETA end of day.
ci-bot: Deploy plan: PR 5021 (kevin) -> runner canary on canary-ml, then PR 5022 (oliver) -> console staging. Will run scorecard against canary once both merged.
maria: :thumbsup: Add a changelog entry and a CI test that asserts per-sample weighting invariants when token_trim toggled.
sri: Temporarily rolling back the FP8 baseline comparison until we have telemetry. Anyone object?
eva: No objections. I'll cancel the dependent rollout and notify infra.
kevin: Working on PR now. I will include backwards-compatible telemetry keys (raw_token_count) to avoid breaking old dashboards.
oliver: I'll also add a unit test for the SQL aggregate so we don't silently pick the wrong denom again.
maria: If we need a fast rollback on hosted, ping infra for a short maintenance window — but let's try the instrumentation first.
sri: Screenshot of the worst drilldown here: https://img.redwood/internal/trunc-drill-4888.png  — lots of samples with 0 trimmed tokens.
kevin: Good catch. Will update when PR is up.
